name: Paycheque split planner
audience: Anyone who wants a payday rule before the money is spent.
summary: Divide one net pay across bills, savings, spending, and giving, and check that the split is 100%.
description: Enter net pay and the percentage you want in each job. The workbook converts percentages to rand and warns you when the percentages do not add up.
benefits: Turn percentages into rand on payday
See immediately if the split is short of or over 100%
Keep giving and saving as planned amounts, not leftovers
compatibility: Microsoft Excel for Microsoft 365 or Excel 2021 and later
Formulas also open in Google Sheets; confirm PMT, FV, and NPER after import
PDF guide opens in any PDF reader
DOCX guide opens in Microsoft Word or Google Docs
disclaimer: This workbook organises figures you type in. It is not financial, credit, insurance, or tax advice. Rates, fees, and laws change. A qualified adviser should review decisions that affect debt, tax, medical cover, or retirement.
